doc: Act 1 firsts (TASK-130, docs/codex.md). kind: monster|area|waypoint|shrine|drop|champion|death. match: names compared case-insensitively against FirstEvent.Name, '*' matches any; area: only when the event area equals it. A row without 'question' fills the Codex without opening a thought. tipTag: V verified, S secondary (SME), U unverified. defaultByClass overrides default for a class in the catalogue's class table. An event fires at most one first, the first matching row in table order, so a more specific row goes before a general one.

point.question: A first for this hero: the question is in the situation.

firsts.title: Fallen
firsts.tip: Fallen run when a Shaman or the leader dies; do not chase them into the dark.
firsts.question: First Fallen pack: they flee when their leader dies. Fight them in a corridor, not in the open?
firsts.teaches: chokepoint over open ground
firsts.consequence: the card says 'held the corridor' or 'fought in the open'

firsts.title: Fallen Shaman
firsts.tip: Shamans resurrect the pack; they die first or the fight never ends.
firsts.question: First Fallen Shaman: they raise the dead pack. Kill shamans first?
firsts.teaches: shamans are priority targets
firsts.consequence: the target order puts shamans first; the card shows shamans killed

firsts.title: Quill Rats
firsts.tip: Spikes chip a low-level hero; rush the rat or leave the line of fire.
firsts.question: Quill Rats spit spikes from range. Close in on them, or keep away from the volley?
firsts.teaches: ranged chip damage is closed or avoided, not tanked
firsts.consequence: the card counts chip damage taken

firsts.title: Corpsefire
firsts.tip: Fight him at the cave mouth and keep moving; standing in his fire costs potions.
firsts.question: Corpsefire: a unique in the Den, burns what stands near. Kite him instead of standing?
firsts.teaches: kite a fire unique under clvl 5 (the default for casters; melee builds stand)
firsts.consequence: the card says 'kited Corpsefire' or 'stood against Corpsefire'; the Den skill point follows the kill

firsts.title: Bishibosh
firsts.tip: He runs with fast Fallen; fight where you can retreat, then go on to the waypoint.
firsts.question: Bishibosh and his pack are fast. Fight in the open, or fall back to the road?
firsts.teaches: fast packs are fought with a retreat behind us
firsts.consequence: the card shows the closest call of that fight

firsts.title: Rakanishu
firsts.tip: Lightning enchanted: his hits chain; stay at range and keep the belt filled.
firsts.question: Rakanishu is lightning enchanted. Fight him now?
firsts.teaches: lightning enchanted uniques are fought from range with a full belt
firsts.consequence: the card says 'fought' or 'skipped'

firsts.title: Blood Raven
firsts.tip: Her fire arrows and raised skeletons end careless level 6 heroes; level up in the Moor first.
firsts.question: Blood Raven sighted. Attempt her this trip (level 6; veterans wait for 8)?
firsts.teaches: the first wall: avoid below range, fight in range
firsts.consequence: the card shows 'fought and kited' or 'avoided'

firsts.title: Dark Archers
firsts.tip: Archers out-range most early casters; the corner is stronger than the open field.
firsts.question: First archers at range. Rush them, or break line of sight?
firsts.teaches: ranged packs are closed on or ducked
firsts.consequence: the card counts arrows taken

firsts.title: Treehead Woodfist
firsts.tip: Killing him is not required for the scroll (S SME round 3).
firsts.question: Treehead Woodfist guards the Tree of Inifuss. Kill him for the loot?
firsts.teaches: optional bosses are chosen
firsts.consequence: the card names the loot or the skipped boss

firsts.title: Griswold
firsts.tip: His gear is the prize; he is tougher than anything before Tristram.
firsts.question: Griswold in Tristram. Fight him now?
firsts.teaches: Tristram bosses are optional
firsts.consequence: the card names the drop or the skip

firsts.title: The Countess
firsts.tip: She drops El to Tir runes; her dungeon is long and the supplies run out.
firsts.question: The Countess, last floor of the Forgotten Tower. Go in for runes?
firsts.teaches: a rune farm needs a full kit
firsts.consequence: the card counts the runes dropped

firsts.title: Andariel
firsts.tip: Poison is the killer: poison resistance and antidotes first.
firsts.question: Andariel, Act 1 final. Attempt her now?
firsts.teaches: the Act 1 boss waits for resistances and antidotes
firsts.consequence: the card says 'Andariel down' or 'not yet'

firsts.title: Blood Moor
firsts.tip: The first field; the Den of Evil is the cave at its far side.

firsts.title: Den of Evil
firsts.tip: Every monster dead earns a free skill point from Akara.
firsts.question: The Den of Evil, a cave with no waypoint. Clear it all for Akara's skill point?
firsts.teaches: the Den is cleared to the last monster
firsts.consequence: Akara's skill point is the first unlock

firsts.title: Cold Plains
firsts.tip: Light the waypoint before anything else.
firsts.question: Cold Plains: the road to the Burial Grounds. Stay and farm, or press on?
firsts.teaches: farm the plains until the waypoint is lit and in range
firsts.consequence: the next orders start from the waypoint

firsts.title: Stony Field
firsts.tip: The five Cairn Stones open the portal to Tristram once the scroll is deciphered.
firsts.question: Stony Field: open, with the Cairn Stones. Look for them now?
firsts.teaches: optional quest objects are hunted when asked
firsts.consequence: the card names the Cairn Stones found or skipped

firsts.title: Burial Grounds
firsts.tip: Level 8 is the veteran line; the Rogue camp is beyond.
firsts.question: The Burial Grounds belong to Blood Raven. Enter before level 8?
firsts.teaches: Blood Raven's ground waits for level 8
firsts.consequence: the card says 'entered' or 'waited'

firsts.title: Cave
firsts.tip: Corridors punish casters who wake two packs.
firsts.question: A cave: tight corridors, two packs at once. Fight at the entrance?
firsts.teaches: caves are fought from the entrance
firsts.consequence: the card shows the closest call of the cave

firsts.title: Dark Wood
firsts.tip: The scroll is part of the Cain quest.
firsts.question: Dark Wood: dense, dark, the Tree of Inifuss. Hunt the tree now?
firsts.teaches: the Tree of Inifuss is part of the Cain quest
firsts.consequence: the card names the scroll found or skipped

firsts.title: Black Marsh
firsts.tip: Its waypoint shortens every later trip.

firsts.title: Forgotten Tower
firsts.tip: Level 12 or more, with resistances, before the last floor.
firsts.question: The Forgotten Tower: deep, with the Countess. Run it at this level?
firsts.teaches: the Forgotten Tower is run only with level and resistances
firsts.consequence: the card says 'ran the Forgotten Tower' or 'levelled first'

firsts.title: Cold Plains waypoint
firsts.tip: A lit waypoint is a shorter trip every time.
firsts.question: Cold Plains waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.tip: A lit waypoint is a shorter trip every time.
firsts.question: Stony Field waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.tip: A lit waypoint is a shorter trip every time.
firsts.question: Black Marsh waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.question: Outer Cloister waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.question: Jail waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.title: Catacombs Level 2 waypoint
firsts.tip: A lit waypoint is a shorter trip every time.
firsts.question: Catacombs waypoint lit: start trips here from now on?
firsts.teaches: trips start at the furthest lit waypoint in range
firsts.consequence: the next order starts here; the card shows the waypoint lit

firsts.title: First shrine
firsts.tip: Most shrines help for a minute or two; a few cost.
firsts.question: First shrine: take shrines when no pack is near?
firsts.teaches: shrines are taken when the screen is calm
firsts.consequence: the card names the shrine and its effect

firsts.title: First rune
firsts.tip: Runes are worth keeping for a recipe or a runeword.
firsts.question: First rune. Keep all runes?
firsts.teaches: runes are kept
firsts.consequence: the stash line grows; the card names the rune

firsts.title: First unique
firsts.tip: A unique is either good now or good in the stash; sell only the plainly useless.
firsts.question: First unique item. Keep every unique?
firsts.teaches: uniques are kept
firsts.consequence: the card names the best drop

firsts.title: First set item
firsts.tip: A single set piece rarely beats a good rare, but the full set does.
firsts.question: First set piece. Keep set items?
firsts.teaches: set pieces are kept
firsts.consequence: the stash line grows

firsts.title: First rare
firsts.tip: Rares are rolled at identify; a scroll is cheap.
firsts.question: First rare item. Identify it right away?
firsts.teaches: rares are identified in town
firsts.consequence: the card shows the identify reveal

firsts.title: Champion with notable mods
firsts.tip: Extra Fast, Cursed and Lightning Enchanted decide most early deaths.
firsts.question: This pack has dangerous mods. Fight it anyway?
firsts.teaches: notable mods lower the engage line
firsts.consequence: the card names the mods

firsts.title: First champion pack
firsts.tip: Champions hit twice as hard and have more life; fight them with life to spare.
firsts.question: First champion pack: fight it above 60 percent life?
firsts.teaches: champion packs are fought with life in hand (t0.unique.fight)
firsts.consequence: the card shows the closest call

firsts.title: First death
firsts.tip: A death is information: the Codex keeps the killer and the place.
firsts.question: First death. Avoid this killer until level 8?
firsts.teaches: the killer is avoided until the hero outlevels it (t0.retreat.lethal)
firsts.consequence: the card names the killer; the rule applies on the next trip
